questions.question: Kis word mein letter 'w' silent hai?
questions.explanation: 'wrist' mein w bola nahi jaata, word 'rist' jaisa sunai deta hai. window, swim aur between mein w clearly bola jaata hai.

questions.question: Word 'information' mein kitne syllables hain?
questions.explanation: in-for-ma-tion: chaar alag vowel sounds hain, isliye 4 syllables. Vowel letters (i, o, a, i, o = 5) gin kar 5 bolna common galti hai.

questions.question: Kis word mein stress **pehle** syllable par hai?
questions.explanation: GARden mein stress pehle syllable par hai. hoTEL, aGREE aur maCHINE teeno mein stress doosre syllable par hai.

questions.question: Sentence 'The kids played outside after lunch' mein word 'after' kaunsa part of speech hai?
questions.explanation: 'after' ke baad noun 'lunch' aaya hai aur woh time ka relation dikhata hai, isliye yahan woh preposition hai. Conjunction tab hota jab uske baad poora clause aata, jaise 'after we ate lunch'.

questions.question: Sahi option chuno: 'Every morning my father ___ the newspaper.'
questions.explanation: 'Every morning' roz ki aadat batata hai, isliye simple present aayega; subject 'my father' singular hai, toh verb 'reads' hoga. 'reading' akela verb nahi ban sakta aur 'are' singular subject ke saath galat hai.

questions.question: In chaar words mein se kis word mein 'oo' ka vowel sound baaki teeno se alag hai?
questions.explanation: food, moon aur pool mein 'oo' lamba 'uu' sound hai, jabki book mein chhota 'u' sound hai (jaise 'put' mein). Spelling same hai, sound alag.

questions.question: Kis word mein main stress **teesre** syllable par hai?
questions.explanation: underSTAND (un-der-stand) mein stress teesre syllable par hai. eLECtric mein stress doosre syllable par hai, aur PHOtograph aur BEAUtiful mein pehle syllable par.

questions.question: Sahi option chuno: 'She ___ for the bus for twenty minutes when it finally came.'
questions.explanation: Bus aane (past) se pehle intezaar 20 minute se chal raha tha, isliye past perfect continuous 'had been waiting' sahi hai. 'has waited' present perfect hai, jo past ki story ('came') ke saath fit nahi hota.

questions.question: Function f(x) = √(x − 3) ka domain (real numbers mein) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Square root ke andar ki value negative nahi ho sakti: x − 3 ≥ 0, yaani x ≥ 3. x = 3 bhi allowed hai kyunki √0 = 0.

questions.question: Points (1, 2) aur (4, 11) se guzarne wali line ka slope kya hai?
questions.explanation: Slope = (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁) = (11 − 2)/(4 − 1) = 9/3 = 3. Fraction ulta le lena (1/3) common galti hai.

questions.question: Agar f(x) = 2x + 1 aur g(x) = x², toh (f∘g)(3), yaani f(g(3)), kya hai?
questions.explanation: Pehle andar wala function: g(3) = 9. Phir f(9) = 2·9 + 1 = 19. 49 = g(f(3)) hai, yaani order ulta kar diya.

questions.question: Quadratic equation 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0 ke roots kya hain?
questions.explanation: Factor karo: 2x² − 7x + 3 = (2x − 1)(x − 3), toh x = 1/2 ya x = 3. Check: roots ka sum 7/2 = −b/a aur product 3/2 = c/a.

questions.question: log₂ 8 + log₃ 9 ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: 2³ = 8 isliye log₂ 8 = 3, aur 3² = 9 isliye log₃ 9 = 2. Total 3 + 2 = 5.

questions.question: f(x) = (3x − 2)/5 ka inverse function f⁻¹(x) kya hai?
questions.explanation: y = (3x − 2)/5 likho aur x nikaalo: 5y = 3x − 2, toh x = (5y + 2)/3. Isliye f⁻¹(x) = (5x + 2)/3. 5/(3x − 2) reciprocal hai, inverse nahi.

questions.question: sin²(π/6) + cos²(π/3) + tan(π/4) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: π/6 = 30° aur π/3 = 60°. sin 30° = 1/2 aur cos 60° = 1/2, toh 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2, aur tan 45° = 1; total 3/2. Yahan dono angles alag hain, isliye sin² + cos² = 1 seedha lagana (answer 2) galat hai.

questions.question: Point (2, −1) se guzarne wali aur line 2x − 3y + 6 = 0 ke perpendicular line ki equation kya hai?
questions.explanation: Di gayi line ka slope 2/3 hai, toh perpendicular slope −3/2 hoga. y + 1 = −3/2 (x − 2) se 2y + 2 = −3x + 6, yaani 3x + 2y − 4 = 0. 2x − 3y − 7 = 0 point se guzarti hai par parallel hai, perpendicular nahi.

questions.question: Ek automatic street light mein LDR (light sensor) andhera detect karta hai, microcontroller decide karta hai, aur LED lamp jalta hai. Is system ke block diagram mein LDR kis block mein aayega?
questions.explanation: LDR bahar ki physical quantity (light) ko electrical signal mein badalta hai, isliye woh input/sensor block hai. Microcontroller processing block hai aur LED lamp output.

questions.question: Ek wire mein 2 minute tak 0.5 A ka steady current behta hai. Kitna charge flow hua?
questions.explanation: Q = I × t, aur time seconds mein lena hai: 2 min = 120 s. Q = 0.5 × 120 = 60 C. Minutes mein hi multiply karne se 1 C aata hai, jo galat hai.

questions.question: Ek 9 V battery ko 1.5 kΩ resistor ke across lagaya gaya. Resistor se kitna current behega?
questions.explanation: Ohm's law: I = V/R = 9 / 1500 = 0.006 A = 6 mA. V × R (13.5) karna galat hai; current I = V/R hota hai.

questions.question: 6 Ω aur 3 Ω resistors parallel mein hain, aur yeh combination ek 4 Ω resistor ke saath series mein hai. Total equivalent resistance kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Parallel: 6 × 3 / (6 + 3) = 18/9 = 2 Ω. Series mein 4 Ω jodo: 2 + 4 = 6 Ω. 13 Ω tab aata jab teeno series mein hote.

questions.question: Ek voltage divider mein 12 V supply ke across R1 = 10 kΩ (upar) aur R2 = 20 kΩ (neeche, ground se juda) series mein hain. R2 ke across output voltage kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Vout = Vin × R2/(R1 + R2) = 12 × 20/30 = 8 V. 4 V R1 ke across ka voltage hai, aur dono milkar 12 V banate hain (KVL).

questions.question: Ek 1.5 kW room heater roz 40 minute chalta hai. 30 din mein yeh kitni electrical energy use karega?
questions.explanation: Energy = Power × time. Roz: 1.5 kW × (40/60) h = 1 kWh, toh 30 din mein 1 × 30 = 30 kWh (yaani 30 units). Minutes ko hours mein badle bina 1,800 aata hai, aur 1 kWh sirf ek din ki energy hai.

questions.question: Ek 21 V source ke saath 3 Ω resistor series mein hai, aur uske baad 6 Ω aur 12 Ω resistors aapas mein parallel mein lage hain (jo circuit poora karte hain). 12 Ω resistor se kitna current behega?
questions.explanation: 6 ∥ 12 = 72/18 = 4 Ω, total = 3 + 4 = 7 Ω, toh source current = 21/7 = 3 A. Parallel part ke across voltage = 3 × 4 = 12 V, isliye 12 Ω mein 12/12 = 1 A behta hai (aur 6 Ω mein 2 A; KCL: 1 + 2 = 3 A).

questions.question: Ek single loop mein 24 V source aur teen resistors series mein hain: 2 kΩ, 4 kΩ aur ek unknown R. 4 kΩ ke across 8 V measure hota hai. R ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Series current I = 8 V / 4 kΩ = 2 mA, toh 2 kΩ ke across 2 mA × 2 kΩ = 4 V. KVL se R ke across 24 − 8 − 4 = 12 V, isliye R = 12 V / 2 mA = 6 kΩ. 12 kΩ poore loop ka total resistance hai, sirf R nahi.

questions.question: C program mein `printf()` aur `scanf()` use karne ke liye kaunsi header file include karni chahiye?
questions.explanation: `stdio.h` (standard input/output) mein `printf` aur `scanf` declared hain. `math.h` maths functions ke liye hai, jaise `sqrt`.

questions.question: `double` type ke variable mein `scanf()` se value read karne ke liye kaunsa format specifier sahi hai?
questions.explanation: `scanf` mein `double` ke liye `%lf` chahiye; `%f` `float` ke liye hai. `%d` `int` ke liye aur `%c` `char` ke liye hota hai.

questions.question: Neeche diye code ka output kya hoga? (`stdio.h` included hai aur code `main()` ke andar hai.)
questions.code:
int a = 17, b = 5;
printf("%d %d", a / b, a % b);
questions.explanation: Dono variables `int` hain, isliye `17 / 5` integer division hai aur fractional part kat jaata hai: 3. `17 % 5` remainder deta hai: 17 − 15 = 2.

questions.question: Ek typical 32/64-bit system par (jahan `int` 4 bytes ka hota hai), `sizeof(char) + sizeof(float) + sizeof(double)` ki value kya hogi?
questions.explanation: `char` hamesha 1 byte, aur typical system par `float` 4 bytes aur `double` 8 bytes ka hota hai: 1 + 4 + 8 = 13. `double` ko `float` jitna (4) maan lena 9 deta hai.

questions.question: Is statement ke baad `x` ki value kya hogi?
questions.explanation: `*`, `/` aur `%` ki precedence `+` aur `-` se zyada hai, aur same level par left se right chalte hain: `3 * 2 = 6`, `6 % 4 = 2`, `8 / 3 = 2` (integer division). Phir `5 + 2 - 2 = 5`.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: `a++` pehle purani value (4) use karta hai, phir a = 5 hota hai: b = 4 + 2 = 6. `++a` pehle badhata hai (a = 6), phir use karta hai: c = 6 * 2 = 12. Final a = 6.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: i ki values 1, 4, 7, 10 hain: i = 1 (odd) s = -1, i = 4 (even) s = 3, i = 7 (odd) s = 2, i = 10 (even) s = 12. Uske baad i = 13 hota hai aur `i <= 10` false ho jaata hai, isliye loop ke baad i = 13 print hota hai.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: `&&` mein pehli condition `x != 0` false hai, toh `y / x` evaluate hi nahi hota (short-circuit), isliye division by zero nahi hota. `else if` mein `x == 0` true hai, toh `||` bhi short-circuit karta hai aur `++y` chalta hi nahi, y = 5 rehta hai. Output `B 5` hai.
